product_overview: Storm44 is a 3-panel AI-powered study workspace (Sources / Chat / Study Tools) that turns user-provided materials into organized notes, flashcards, quizzes, and a small learning game while surfacing traceable citations back to sources.
core_goals: Provide a resizable 3-panel notebook workspace (Sources / Chat / Study Tools) that supports quick source-to-study workflows
Deliver chat responses with clickable citations that open the referenced source excerpt
Allow creation, editing, studying, and basic management of flashcards and decks scoped to notebooks
Keep the UI responsive and keyboard-accessible for typical student workflows

features.name: Notebook Dropdown Selector
features.description: Header dropdown for switching between notebooks, creating new notebooks, inline renaming, and deleting notebooks (delete disabled when only one exists).
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click notebook name in header to open dropdown -> See list of notebooks with active notebook highlighted -> Click a notebook to switch to it -> See header display the selected notebook name

Navigate to / -> Click notebook name in header to open dropdown -> Click "New Notebook" button at bottom of dropdown -> Type new notebook name in inline rename field -> Press Enter to confirm rename -> See new notebook appear and become active in the header

Navigate to / -> Click notebook name in header to open dropdown -> Click pencil icon next to a notebook to start inline rename -> Type new name -> Press Escape to cancel rename -> See original notebook name unchanged

Navigate to / -> Click notebook name in header to open dropdown -> If only one notebook exists, observe trash icon hidden or disabled -> Attempt to delete last notebook is not possible -> See toast or inline message indicating deletion is not allowed

features.name: Flashcard Deck List
features.description: Grid view of flashcard decks scoped to the active notebook; supports create, inline rename, delete, and shows card count and last-studied time.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open Study Tools tab in right panel and select Flashcards tab -> See empty state with "Create Deck" button when no decks exist

Navigate to / -> Open Study Tools tab in right panel and select Flashcards tab -> Click "Create Deck" button -> Type deck name in inline rename field -> Press Enter to confirm -> See new deck card appear in grid with card count and last studied time

Navigate to / -> Open Study Tools tab in right panel and select Flashcards tab -> Click a deck card to open the flashcard viewer for that deck -> See flashcard viewer open with deck title and card count

Navigate to / -> Open Study Tools tab in right panel and select Flashcards tab -> Click pencil icon on a deck card to start inline rename -> Clear the name and press Enter -> See validation error or name unchanged and inline feedback indicating name required
Navigate to / -> Open Study Tools tab in right panel and select Flashcards tab -> Click trash icon on a deck card -> Confirm deletion if prompted -> See deck removed from grid and card count updated

features.name: Flashcard Viewer with 3D Flip
features.description: Interactive study view with 3D card flip animation, keyboard shortcuts (Space/Enter to flip, arrow keys to navigate), progress bar, and add-card entry point.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open Study Tools tab in right panel and select Flashcards tab -> Click a deck card to open the flashcard viewer for that deck -> See deck title and card count in viewer header

Navigate to / -> Open Study Tools tab and select Flashcards tab -> Click a deck card to open flashcard viewer -> Click the card or press Space to flip between front and back -> See the opposite side of the card rendered with 3D flip animation

Navigate to / -> Open Study Tools tab and select Flashcards tab -> Click a deck card to open flashcard viewer -> Click right arrow or press ArrowRight to navigate to next card -> See progress bar update to reflect new position in deck

Navigate to / -> Open Study Tools tab and select Flashcards tab -> Click a deck card for a deck that has no cards -> See empty state when deck has no cards -> Click "Add Card" button to open the add card form

Navigate to / -> Open Study Tools tab and select Flashcards tab -> Click a deck card to open flashcard viewer -> On the last card press ArrowRight -> See end-of-deck state or no change and an indicator that user is at the last card

features.name: Flashcard Form
features.description: Form to add new flashcards with front and back text fields, Add Card / Add & Another / Cancel behaviors, and disabled submit when fields are empty.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open Study Tools tab and select Flashcards tab -> Open a deck in the flashcard viewer -> Click "Add Card" button to open the flashcard form -> Fill in front text field with question or term -> Fill in back text field with answer or definition -> Click "Add Card" -> See card saved and returned to viewer with card count incremented

Navigate to / -> Open Study Tools tab and select Flashcards tab -> Open a deck in the flashcard viewer -> Click "Add Card" button to open the flashcard form -> Fill in both fields and click "Add & Another" -> See card saved and form cleared for new card entry

Navigate to / -> Open Study Tools tab and select Flashcards tab -> Open a deck in the flashcard viewer -> Click "Add Card" button to open the flashcard form -> Leave front or back field empty -> Observe the submit button disabled -> Click "Cancel" -> See form discarded and return to viewer

features.name: Notebook and Flashcard Context Providers
features.description: React context providers that manage in-memory notebook and flashcard state (CRUD operations, active notebook tracking) and propagate updates across the UI.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Use notebook dropdown to create a new notebook -> Create a deck in Study Tools scoped to the active notebook -> Add a flashcard to the deck -> Observe notebook name update in header and new deck/card appear immediately across the UI

Navigate to / -> Create notebook, create deck, add cards -> Interact with notebook dropdown, deck list, and flashcard viewer -> See state consistently updated across components without explicit reload
Navigate to / -> Create notebooks, decks, and cards -> Refresh the browser page -> See notebooks and flashcards reset to initial state and any created data lost due to in-memory-only storage

routes.description: Main workspace page with 3-panel layout including header, sources, chat, and study tools

features.name: Notebook Dropdown Selector
features.description: Dropdown in the header that lets users switch between notebooks, create new notebooks, inline rename notebooks, and delete notebooks
user_interactions: Click notebook name in header to open dropdown
See list of notebooks with active notebook highlighted
Click a notebook to switch to it
Click pencil icon to start inline rename of a notebook
Type new name and press Enter or click check to confirm rename
Press Escape or click X to cancel rename
Click trash icon to delete a notebook (only if more than 1 exists)
Click "New Notebook" button at bottom of dropdown to create a new notebook

features.name: Flashcard Deck List
features.description: Grid view of flashcard decks within the Flashcards tab of the Study Tools panel, scoped to the active notebook. Supports creating, renaming, and deleting decks.
user_interactions: See empty state with "Create Deck" button when no decks exist
Click "Create Deck" or "New Deck" button to create a new deck with inline rename
Click a deck card to open the flashcard viewer for that deck
Click pencil icon on a deck card to inline rename
Click trash icon on a deck card to delete it
See card count and last studied time on each deck card

features.name: Flashcard Viewer with 3D Flip
features.description: Interactive flashcard study view with 3D card flip animation, progress bar, and previous/next navigation. Supports keyboard shortcuts.
user_interactions: See deck title and card count in viewer header
Click card or press Space/Enter to flip between front and back
Click left/right arrows or press arrow keys to navigate between cards
See progress bar showing position within deck
Click back button to return to deck list
Click "Add Card" button to open the add card form
See empty state when deck has no cards

features.name: Flashcard Form
features.description: Form to add new flashcards to a deck with front and back text fields
user_interactions: Fill in front text field with question or term
Fill in back text field with answer or definition
Click "Add Card" to save card and return to viewer
Click "Add & Another" to save card and stay on form for another
Click "Cancel" to discard and return to viewer
Submit button is disabled when either field is empty

features.name: Notebook and Flashcard Context Providers
features.description: React context providers wrapping the app that manage notebook and flashcard state (CRUD operations, active notebook tracking)
user_interactions: State is managed automatically as users interact with notebook and flashcard features

known_limitations.issue: Notebook and flashcard data is stored in React state only, not persisted to localStorage or backend
known_limitations.impact: All data is lost on page refresh

known_limitations.issue: Quizzes and Game tabs in Study Tools are placeholder UI only
known_limitations.impact: Generate Quiz and Start Game buttons have no functionality
